sample_unit: model-question annotations by clinicians (RCQ benchmark; plus 500 MedQA and 500 HealthBench items)

links.outcome: Specialized clinical AI tools versus frontier LLMs on same benchmarks and real clinical queries
links.effect: Frontier LLMs outperformed clinical AI tools in all three evaluations (MedQA, HealthBench, RCQ); clinical AI tools performed comparably to Google Search AI Overview on the RCQ.
links.quote: Frontier LLMs outperformed clinical AI tools in all three evaluations.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial clinical AI tools (OpenEvidence, UpToDate Expert AI) vs frontier LLMs across benchmarks including retrospective real clinical queries rated by clinicians, but does not test a deployment guardrail or practice.
